summary: When someone is sick, a neighbor brings a meal; more people say they would give than expect to receive.
realLife: About two thirds said they would bring a meal to a sick neighbor or friend, while fewer expected the same in return; older adults were more willing.
sources: Pew Research Center, how connected Americans feel to neighbors (March 2025 survey): https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2025/05/08/how-connected-do-americans-feel-to-their-neighbors/
inGame: an illness record on a person with neighbor and friend ties; the neighbor's visit is a tie event

turns.summary: A neighbor arrives with a meal and stays to talk.
turns.writesBack: tie warms; the illness is shared knowledge

turns.summary: The sick person gets no visitor and notices.
A neighbor brings the meal only after hearing it from a third person.
